1. Blur the image with a Gaussian of the given sigma.
2. Subtract the blur from the image to get the detail.
3. Where the detail reaches the threshold, add amount times the detail to the image.
4. Elsewhere keep the pixel.
5. Clip to 0 to 255 and round to 8 bits. Keep alpha unchanged.
